cohort: The study participants were 1460 pregnant and postpartum women recruited for the Rajarata Pregnancy Cohort from the Anuradhapura district, Sri Lanka.
finding: During the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, the household economies of pregnant women in rural Sri Lanka were severely affected, pushing families into poverty, while their healthcare utilisation was minimally affected.
cross-section timing: during the initial stage of the COVID-19 pandemic
